decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w9' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4401. Series context: trend strength 0.9068 and seasonal strength 0.2316; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.197); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 9.7.
